sections.text:
Retractable awnings, also known as folding arm awnings, are an excellent solution for enhancing outdoor living spaces in Melbourne. They provide shade and protection from the elements while maintaining an open and airy feel. Here are some reputable providers in Melbourne that offer custom retractable awnings:

**[Amaru](http://amarumelbourne.com.au/?utm_source=openai)**  
**Closed · Restaurant · A$200+ · 4.7 (538 reviews)**  
_1121 High St, Armadale VIC 3143, Australia_  
Specializes in custom-made retractable awnings, offering various fabric choices and control options, including motorized systems.

**[MELBOURNE AWNINGS](http://melbourneawnings.com.au/?utm_source=openai)**  
**Closed · Corporate office**  
_Union St, Brighton East VIC 3187, Australia_  
Provides a range of retractable awnings, including folding arm and sunroof awnings, with motorization options for ease of use.

**[Nu-Style Home Improvements](http://www.nustylehomeimprovements.com.au/?utm_source=openai)**  
**Open now · Awning supplier · 2.3 (35 reviews)**  
_1/90 Derby St, Pascoe Vale VIC 3044, Australia_  
Provides folding arm awnings suitable for patios, balconies, and commercial environments, with options for customization.

**[Portside Shutters & Blinds | Awnings, Curtains & Plantation Shutters](https://www.portsideshutters.com.au/?utm_source=openai)**  
**Open now · Blinds shop · 4.8 (51 reviews)**  
_465 High St, Prahran VIC 3181, Australia_  
Offers both fixed and retractable awning fixtures, including cassette folding arm awnings, tailored for residential and commercial properties.

**[Skyline Shades](https://skylineshades.com.au/?utm_medium=GMB+organic&utm_source=openai)**  
**Open now · Blinds shop · 5.0 (3 reviews)**  
_14 Lonhro Bvd, Cranbourne West VIC 3977, Australia_  
Designs and installs custom folding arm awnings with manual, motorized, and fully automated options, suitable for various outdoor areas.

When selecting a retractable awning, consider factors such as the size of the area to be covered, desired fabric material, control options (manual or motorized), and additional features like wind or sun sensors. It's advisable to consult with these providers to determine the best solution tailored to your specific needs and preferences.
